Been building open-source Postgres tools for a decade now, and one things keeps popping up... it's way too easy to build insecure databases. It gives you two independent grades: security and performance. It also runs in CI, so you can improve your development loop. We found that agents that can see your CI will just pick this up and start improving your code w/o too much instruction. I'd love feedback from anyone who's worked with complex RLS policies, multi-tenant Postgres, or agent-generated schemas.
